title: Stable supporting-actor identities and dynamic participation without changing Nadia root

classification_detail.detail: P2Owner constructor, validate_proposal and realize entry points keep the existing call shapes. Supporting actors are registered through the existing C12 branch/world/checkpoint. Root and focal invariants are unchanged. A's six C01 tests pass unchanged.

The persisted P2Owner binding row changes from mutable {'participants': [...]} to {'root_participants': root actor tuple}. Existing rows are read and migrated when root/branch/source match and the stored list names the focal actor. This removes the cross-scope P2_OWNER_BINDING_MISMATCH lockout that broke the ordinary P3 reopen shape after a C01 owner opened the same root.

read_actor_access now requires a supporting actor's participation episode and co_present receipt in addition to its registration and perception row. A bare/forged perception row no longer grants event access.

p2_owner.py byte change alters P3Owner._code_pins()/config_hash. Same-code roots reopen; pre-B01/pre-C01 roots refuse cold reopen. No migration was invented and no native actor/science/right/merge authority is issued.
Role allowlist remains parent only. No second owner, scheduler, world, clock, database or material ledger is added. Module-level material functions/material_fact, house.py and P3 code are untouched.
